svg.text: One fragment's LLVM module ("out") after CodegenPhase, before LinkBitcodeDependenciesPhase
Target triple, data layout and the struct types TypeInfo, ObjHeader, InitNode, InterfaceTableRecord come from compiler_interface.bc.
Globals (data)
per class C with requiresRtti() - LlvmDeclarations.kt, RTTIGenerator.kt
kclass:C = { TypeInfo, [N x ptr] } vtable attached if non-abstract
kintf:C krefs:C kifacetable:C constant arrays the TypeInfo points to
ktypew:C writable TypeInfo (exported); type kclassbody:C#internal
static state
kvar:pkg.name static field (global)
@ThreadLocal field: TLS slot, read via LookupTLS(__KonanTlsKey, index)
kobjref:Fq / kobjget:Fq exported singleton storage; theUnitInstance
state_global$container (intptr, internal); state_thread_local$container
permanent constants - KotlinStaticData.kt, Boxing.kt
unnamed private globals: string literals, IrConstantValue objects, boxes
OBJECT_TAG_PERMANENT set in the ObjHeader: never scanned or freed
start-up records - IrToBitcode.kt appendStaticInitializers
init_node { initializer, next } one per library compiled into this module
_Konan_init_lib_guard (i32); llvm.global_ctors = [ _Konan_constructors ]
llvm.used (retainAnnotation); KotlinObjCClassInfo records; ObjC adapters
prefix:name symbols are the ABI (KonanBinaryInterface);
#internal names stay private to the module; global_ctors only in final binaries.
Functions (code)
Kotlin functions - BinaryInterface.kt, ContextUtils.linkageOf
kfun:mangled exported, external linkage
fq#internal not exported, internal linkage (file-qualified in per-file caches)
overridable method: trampoline under the public name, body at name-impl
<bridge-DIRS>name bridges, reached only through vtable/itable slots
initialization - static-initializers.md
$init_global$file, $init_thread_local, eager variants, $clinit_trigger
_Konan_init_lib one ctor per library (declared only, if the library is cached)
_Konan_constructors calls every ctor (final binaries)
entry point and foreign-facing symbols
Konan_start (programs, @ExportForCppRuntime, EntryPoint.kt) calls main
literal C names from @ExportForCppRuntime / @ExportedBridge
C export adapters; Kotlin_ObjCExport_* adapters (export.md)
declared runtime entry points (importRtFunction): AllocInstance, EnterFrame, ...
metadata - DebugUtils.kt, linkModules.kt
DICompileUnit per module, DIFile per IrFileEntry, DISubprogram per function
module flags (SDK version); embedded -l / -framework for static frameworks
Each function with a frame has the blocks prologue, locals_init,
stack_locals_init, entry ..., epilogue and optionally cleanup_landingpad.
Added into the same module afterwards
CStubsPhase: C stubs produced by interop lowerings and compiled by clang.
LinkBitcodeDependenciesPhase (CompilerOutput.kt): C export adapter api.bc; runtime modules (runtime.bc, chosen GC, scheduler, allocator, ...,
plus the generated constants module) only when this module defines the stdlib runtime part; launcher.bc for programs (defines Konan_main),
xctest_launcher.bc, exceptionsSupport.bc (dynamic caches), cinterop klib bitcode, -native-library files, patched objc.bc.
After the LLVM pipelines, InsertEntryPointAliasPhase adds the alias main = Konan_main (programs without -nomain).
